blocks.html: Internal-only query options passed through the DAL layer.

types.name: crossModuleJoins
types.description:
Cross-module join specifications that allows the graph layer to optimize data fetching.
The logic behind what gets passed here is owned by the graph layer, and that layer will ensure
we don't break boundaries between modules other than for performance optimizations.

children.name: parent
children.description:
When set, this join is correlated to the target row of the parent join
instead of the root entity. The value must match the parent join's
`target.table`. Used for multi-hop filters such as filtering orders by a
product's sales channel.

children.name: link
children.description: Describes a link table connecting the queried root entity to an external table.

children.name: schema
children.description: PostgreSQL schema for the link table. Defaults to `public`.

children.name: sourceKey
children.description:
Column on the link table referencing the correlation source — the queried
root entity when there is no `parent`, otherwise the parent join's target row.

children.name: targetKey
children.description: Column on the link table referencing the external entity.

children.name: target
children.description: Describes an external table that can be filtered or sorted against.

children.name: schema
children.description: PostgreSQL schema for the target table. Defaults to `public`.

children.name: primaryKey
children.description: Primary key column on the target table. Defaults to `id`.

children.name: filters
children.description: Filters applied to the target table.
